explore_prose: Every run in this experiment is in the explorer below: filter by outcome to see which settings held the SLOs, or by setting to compare one sweep against another.
Each sweep's hypothesis was written before the runs, and is quoted beside that sweep's measured result below.

hero.html: 3 configurations over 1 sweep (chunk-size), each at 2 load levels, every run on exactly 8 GPUs.

1x TP8 (chunk size 8192), from the chunk-size sweep, reached 69.44 tok/s/accelerator (555.5 tok/s across the fleet) at concurrency 16 while holding the scenario's SLOs. Ranking: max output tok/s per accelerator subject to the scenario's SLOs.

prose: Smaller prefill chunks should cost both tail inter-token latency and time-to-first-token, as each prompt then needs more passes.
